title: Pierwsze kroki
audience: Children from about 8 years old and adult beginners. Everything must be suitable for a child and still respectful of an adult: everyday life, family, school, home, food, animals, hobbies, sport, weather, town, holidays. Nothing about alcohol, violence, romance, money worries, politics or working life. Short sentences. Polish explanations in simple words that a 9-year-old understands, with no linguistic jargon beyond: rzeczownik, czasownik, przymiotnik, czas.
vocabGuide: Genuinely A1-A2 on the CEFR scale (English Vocabulary Profile / Cambridge Dictionary labels): the most frequent everyday words and fixed phrases a beginner needs first. Mostly single words; "collocation" items are simple everyday phrases (have breakfast, go to bed, ride a bike, do homework); phrasal verbs only the most basic (get up, turn on, put on); at most one very common fixed expression per week as "idiom" (How are you?, Well done!), or none. Concrete, picturable words first.
